name: Fog Of Candles
loop: A masked chart runs to a cutoff; swipe right for up, left for down over the next segment; the hidden future wipes in with a reveal animation; 15 cards per round.
hook: Fast swipes, instant reveal, and a calibration score that rewards honest confidence.
risk: Endless rapid loops can feel slot-like; needs session caps and no frequency rewards.

name: Three Bands
loop: Each card asks which of three magnitude bands (flat, moderate, large move) the next stretch lands in; tap a band, see the hidden path draw in, 12 cards.
hook: Magnitude guessing is a fresh skill beyond up or down.
risk: Players may mistake band guesses for trading skill; needs a not-advice label.

name: Slide The Odds
loop: Drag one slider to set your probability that the price ends higher; lock it in, watch the hidden segment reveal, and see the Brier cost on a running meter; 15 cards.
hook: Confidence is the game: bold-and-right pays, bold-and-wrong stings.
risk: Leaderboards can push volume grinding; rank on calibration not card count.

name: Cone Catcher
loop: Drag a shaded cone around where the price will sit at the end; narrower cones score more if they contain the outcome; reveal sweeps the true path through; 12 cards.
hook: Tight-but-right feels like sniping; the trade-off is tactile.
risk: Range scoring is harder to explain; needs a one-line tutorial.

name: Higher High Hunt
loop: Tap yes or no: will the hidden segment print a higher high than the visible peak? Reveal confirms; ten cards in two minutes.
hook: Binary structure questions are quick to learn and punchy.
risk: Hit rate alone ignores luck; show sample-size caveats.

name: Lower Low Dash
loop: Will the next segment undercut the recent low? Tap yes or no; correct calls build a streak multiplier on points that resets on a miss; 10 cards.
hook: Streak tension keeps each tap meaningful.
risk: Streak multipliers reward chasing; cap the multiplier and exclude real trades.

name: Calm Or Storm
loop: Swipe left for a calm future and right for a stormy one on generated charts labelled synthetic; reveal shows realised swing; codex entries unlock for each volatility regime.
hook: Volatility calls teach regimes without any ticker bias.
risk: Synthetic paths must be clearly labelled to avoid implied real-market claims.

name: Gap Or Glide
loop: Cards show a chart before a session boundary; pick gap up, gap down, or no gap; the reveal draws the opening move; a codex page explains each pattern.
hook: Short, spicy questions with a learning payoff.
risk: Codex text must stay educational, never phrased as advice.

name: Overnight Call
loop: Once a day, swipe a probability-weighted up or down on a handful of real markets for tomorrow's close; resolutions arrive next day and update your rating.
hook: Real stakes of attention: tomorrow's result is a reason to return.
risk: Daily return pull is habit-forming; avoid push nagging and loss framing.

name: Closing Bell Trio
loop: Three daily cards with probability sliders on next-close direction; friends see scores only after resolution; season rating moves by calibration.
hook: Small daily ritual with friends comparing calibration.
risk: Social comparison can foster compulsion; keep to three cards and no streak shaming.

name: Delayed Pulse
loop: Watch a delayed-quote sparkline and call the next fifteen-minute-delayed move; energy refills slowly, so you get a bounded set of cards.
hook: Feels live without being live; energy keeps sessions short.
risk: Delay disclosure is required; energy mechanics must not be monetised.

name: Ghost Of Yesterday
loop: Play the same 15 masked cards a friend just played; a ghost bar shows their running score beside yours and you see their confidence only at the end.
hook: Racing a ghost makes a solo loop feel competitive.
risk: Ghost data is user behaviour; share only aggregate-safe scores.

name: Bracket Of Charts
loop: Eight charts face off in pairs; tap which one rises more over the hidden window; winners advance to a final; share the bracket by link.
hook: Bracket structure gives drama from simple relative calls.
risk: Relative picks could look like stock tips if tickers leak; keep masked.

name: Reveal Roulette
loop: Hold a button while the hidden path animates to ride a paper position; release to exit; your capture percentage of the move is the score; 10 cards.
hook: Hold-and-release is visceral and tense.
risk: Slot-machine feel; no celebration effects and no money framing.

name: Echo Pattern
loop: See a visible chart and four candidate futures sketched as ghost lines; tap the one you think matches; the true one lights up; codex tracks which shapes you spot.
hook: Pattern-matching puzzles are satisfying and low-pressure.
risk: Sketches may imply pattern reliability; add a past-patterns disclaimer.

name: Odds Ladder
loop: Each card lists five thresholds; set one probability per threshold forming a ladder; the reveal shows which were crossed; log score punishes certainty errors.
hook: Full distribution thinking feels expert but plays in seconds.
risk: Five sliders per card may overload casual players.

name: Zero Line Duel
loop: Charts are percent-only with the 0% line shown; swipe whether the segment finishes above or below zero; streak multiplier on correct calls; 12 cards.
hook: Zero-line framing is clean and matches the app's chart rules.
risk: Streaks can encourage tilt; reset gently and show calibration beside streak.

name: Two Speed Cards
loop: Per card, tap direction and then a confidence tier; score blends calibration with paper return from the move; slow cards pay more for size, fast cards pay for speed.
hook: Blend of prediction and paper return gives two ways to feel good.
risk: Paper return can swamp calibration and reward risk-taking; weight carefully.

name: Mood Swing Meter
loop: Set a probability that the next segment is more volatile than the last; reveal shows realised range; the codex logs volatility clustering examples as you learn them.
hook: Teaches volatility clustering by feel, not formula.
risk: Synthetic data must not teach false regularities; label as simulated.

name: Fifty Fifty Truth
loop: A weekly 20-card set; the app grades how often your 70 percent calls were right versus a coin; the result card is a calibration curve.
hook: The calibration curve is a satisfying, shareable personal portrait.
risk: Calibration cards must show sample size and not imply future skill.

name: Tick Tack Reveal
loop: One-handed tap game: 3 seconds per card to call up or down; a timer ring shrinks; the reveal draws as a flash; 20 cards.
hook: Pure reflex rhythm that works on a commute.
risk: Speed pressure promotes impulsive habits; keep timer generous and sessions bounded.

name: Sweet Spot Zone
loop: Drag two handles to bracket the end price; the reveal shows whether the real path stayed inside; coverage over many cards is checked against your stated confidence.
hook: Honest intervals feel like a craft you can improve.
risk: Interval jargon is a barrier; use plain words like likely range.

name: Streak Garden
loop: Right calls grow plants in a little garden; wrong calls prune them; plants record calibration bands, not trade counts; 12 cards per visit.
hook: Gentle cosmetic progress without money feel.
risk: Garden decay could be a compulsion loop; no loss-triggered nags.

name: Cliff Edge
loop: Cards ask whether a large drop, a large rise, or neither occurs in the hidden window; the reveal replays it in slow motion; codex logs tail-event types.
hook: Tail awareness is dramatic and educational.
risk: Fear framing; keep tone neutral and show base rates.

name: Base Rate Check
loop: Before each reveal the app shows the base rate for that chart type; you may adjust it with a slider; score rewards beating the base rate, not just being right.
hook: Shows when skill beats the crowd of average cases.
risk: Showing base rates may reduce play excitement; offer a toggle.

name: Duo Of Dials
loop: Two dials per card: chance of an up move and chance of a big move; the reveal scores both; a 2D skill map shows where your calls cluster.
hook: Two-axis feedback feels like rich self-knowledge.
risk: Complexity may lose casual users.

name: Rewind Rescue
loop: Miss a card and you can rewind once per run by predicting a simpler follow-up; each cleared run unlocks a harder modifier, like shorter reveals or fewer hints.
hook: Roguelike ascension on top of fast cards.
risk: Modifier chase may extend sessions; cap runs per day.

name: Volatility Bingo
loop: A bingo grid of statements like a swing larger than the last one; each card's reveal marks squares; complete a line for a cosmetic stamp; synthetic paths labelled.
hook: Bingo adds a light puzzle layer over prediction taps.
risk: Bingo cheer can read like celebration; keep stamps muted.

name: Jury Of Charts
loop: Everyone gets the same 10 masked cards each day; swipe your calls; your rank vs the field is shown after the day closes, with calibration as a tiebreaker.
hook: Same-cards-for-all creates water-cooler comparison.
risk: Rank pressure; show percentiles with confidence ranges.

name: Pick The Pace
loop: Choose among slow drift, sharp spike, or choppy sideways for the hidden window; the reveal animates tempo as a pulse; ten cards.
hook: Describing the path's character, not just its end, is fresh.
risk: Ambiguous labels cause disputes; define buckets with numbers.

name: Half Reveal
loop: The future reveals halfway; you update your earlier call once; score rewards sensible updating versus stubbornness or flip-flopping.
hook: Teaches belief updating in a satisfying two-beat card.
risk: Two-step cards double decisions; keep cards short.

name: Crowd Compass
loop: After you swipe, see what percent of other players went each way; you may revise once; scoring rewards beating the crowd when right and punishes herding when wrong.
hook: Contrarian thrill with real information.
risk: Herd display can anchor players; hide until after commit if tested.

name: Blind Tape
loop: No labels, no axes, only a percent change line from zero; call up or down on the next 20 percent of the path; 15 cards.
hook: Stripped-down purity attracts skill-minded players.
risk: No axis may confuse; keep 0% line visible per chart rules.

name: Season Of Cards
loop: Ten cards a day for a four-week season; friends compare calibration weekly; season ends with a plain-language recap, no prizes.
hook: Short seasons give shape and a reason to return.
risk: Daily seasons risk compulsion; allow skip days without penalty.

name: Double Or Hold
loop: Ride a paper position through the hidden path; at each pause choose to hold or step aside; score is capture divided by worst dip so patience and discipline count.
hook: Rewards discipline, not just luck.
risk: Double-down framing could mimic gambling; avoid doubling mechanics.

name: Opening Sprint
loop: Predict only the first five minutes of the session on masked days; ten tiny cards; quick reveals; streak multiplier displays with a cap.
hook: Tiny horizons make sessions snappy.
risk: Very short horizons are mostly noise; call out that luck dominates.

name: Range Rider
loop: Choose whether the price stays inside, breaks above, or breaks below the visible range; reveal shows the break as a flash; harder tiers use tighter ranges.
hook: Range-break calls are natural and visual.
risk: Breakout talk may sound like signals; keep masked and generic.

name: Three Second Truth
loop: Three rapid swipes a day, three seconds each, a mini reveal, and a one-line takeaway about your tendencies; done in under a minute.
hook: Lowest possible friction daily habit.
risk: Habit loop; offer a skip and an off switch.

name: Slope Sense
loop: Drag a line to sketch the slope you expect over the next segment; scoring checks angle and endpoint tolerance; reveal overlays your sketch on the truth.
hook: Sketching feels creative and the overlay is a delight.
risk: Sketch scoring can be fiddly; forgive small errors.

name: Hot Or Not Quiet
loop: Anonymised closed trades from verified profiles appear as percent-only paths; swipe whether the trade ended in a win or a loss; reveal shows the final percent return.
hook: Plays on the app's own verified data, making records feel alive.
risk: Anonymisation must resist re-identification; k-anonymity and consent needed.

name: Spot The Winner
loop: Four anonymised verified-trade summaries are shown without outcomes; guess which closed positive; the reveal shows all four percent returns; losses are shown equally.
hook: A guessing game that humanises the real feed.
risk: May tempt copying traders; show only generic descriptors and delay.

name: Recap Quiz Cards
loop: Daily ten cards mixing masked history and anonymised verified outcomes, each asking for a bucketed percent return; the codex files patterns you missed.
hook: A varied deck keeps each day fresh.
risk: Mixing data sources may blur the Verified badge; label each card source.

name: Calibration Gym
loop: Twenty cards of events whose answer is known to the system; you set probabilities, then see a calibration plot with reliability bins and a plain verdict like overconfident.
hook: A mirror for your own judgment with visible improvement.
risk: Verdict wording must avoid implying trading ability.

name: Whisper Or Shout
loop: One slider with two modes: whisper for small-move odds, shout for large-move odds; the reveal fills a gauge; 12 cards.
hook: The audio-flavoured metaphor makes magnitude intuitive.
risk: Gimmicky metaphor may obscure the scoring rule.

name: Second Guess Window
loop: Each card gives a three-second window to change your answer after a hint chart reveals; run modifiers like fewer hints or no changes unlock as you improve.
hook: Roguelike modifiers spice the same fast loop.
risk: Difficulty chasing; keep modifiers optional.

name: Patience Test
loop: You may tap pass on any card; correct passes on genuinely 50 percent cards earn points, rushed bad calls cost; the reveal tags each card as clear or coin flip.
hook: Rewarding abstention is a rare, honest design choice.
risk: Scoring abstention fairly is hard; define coin-flip cards with held-out stats.

name: Streak Insurance
loop: A streak shield absorbs one miss per day, replenished by completing a calibration check; fast cards, capped multiplier, limited energy per day.
hook: Forgiving streaks soften tilt.
risk: Shield mechanics are a retention trick; keep it generous and transparent.

name: Beat The Median
loop: A weekly set of 20 masked cards; your probability is compared with the median player's; points accrue when you move closer to the truth than the median.
hook: Beat-the-crowd gives a clean competitive frame.
risk: Median reveals might leak answers; publish only after the week.

name: Layer Cake Chart
loop: Zoom levels stack: first call the next hour, then the next day, then the next week on the same masked chart; each reveal adds a layer to the picture.
hook: Nested horizons make a single card feel like a mini-story.
risk: Three decisions per card could be tedious.

name: Shock Absorber
loop: A card shows a sudden jump in the visible chart; predict whether it continues, fades, or reverses afterwards; reveal and a codex note about momentum versus reversion.
hook: Teaches post-shock behaviour, a classic curiosity.
risk: Momentum lessons could be read as tips; stress that history varies.

name: Bet The Band
loop: Spread 100 probability points over five magnitude bands for the next move; the reveal lights the true band; log score rewards putting weight where reality lands.
hook: Spreading points is tactile and teaches distributions.
risk: Points can read like chips; call them probability points.

name: Echo Chamber Break
loop: The app tracks your bias toward calling up and shows a balance meter after each round; cards are drawn so ups and downs are equally likely, exposing the tilt.
hook: Learning about your own bias is quietly addictive.
risk: Bias labels shouldn't shame; use neutral wording.

name: Tape Reader Duel
loop: Send a friend a link to the same 10 masked cards; each plays on their own time; the app shows a head-to-head calibration comparison afterwards.
hook: Async duels travel by link, no scheduling.
risk: Challenge links are growth hooks; no spam prompts or contact import.

name: Live Duel Sprint
loop: Two friends see the same card at once; first to lock a call gets a small speed edge; reveal is shared; best of eleven.
hook: Real-time rivalry in two minutes.
risk: Speed edges reward impulsive calls; keep edge small.

name: Coach Whisper
loop: After each reveal a short generic note explains what a calibrated forecaster would have noticed; notes never name instruments or give directions.
hook: Reflection after every card turns play into learning.
risk: Generated notes could drift into advice; template and review them.

name: Panic Button
loop: Ride a paper position through a hidden stress path; release anytime; scored on return versus the deepest dip, so early panic and late greed both show up in a replay.
hook: A mirror for emotional reactions with a vivid replay.
risk: Stress framing may trigger anxiety; add a calm exit and explain it is not real.

name: Drift Or Dive
loop: Swipe up for drift upward, down for dive; mild moves count as neutral and your swipe is graded against a dead-zone threshold; 15 cards.
hook: Dead-zone grading is fair to small noise moves.
risk: Dead zones confuse; show the threshold on screen.

name: Pattern Postcards
loop: Each correct round earns a postcard with a stylised chart shape (masked) to collect; the album records the shapes you have predicted well.
hook: Collection gives long-term progress without money.
risk: Collection mechanics reward volume; make cards earned by calibration not count.

name: Coin Flip Court
loop: Half the generated charts are pure random walks; set your probability and then learn whether the chart had any edge; a verdict explains luck versus skill.
hook: A teaching shock: much of what feels like a pattern is noise.
risk: Could discourage users; frame as healthy skepticism.

name: Tomorrow Postcards
loop: Swipe your read on today's close versus tomorrow's for a broad index-like basket; tomorrow a postcard shows what happened, with your calibration trail.
hook: A gentle daily moment with a clear next-day payoff.
risk: Next-day wait may drive checking behaviour; send no push.

name: Big Small Medium
loop: Tap whether the next move is bigger or smaller than the last visible move; reveal measures both bars side by side; multiplier for consecutive correct.
hook: A simple comparison is addictive and easy to teach.
risk: Streak chase; keep multiplier modest.

name: Sudden Death Chart
loop: Keep calling cards until you miss three; each miss shrinks your reveal window; longest run of the day tops a board; limited attempts per day.
hook: Survival tension in a tiny package.
risk: Pure streak boards reward luck; add confidence intervals on rank.

name: Draft The Cards
loop: Before each round, draft six card types such as direction, range, or volatility from three offers; the round then asks only those question types; deck bonuses stack.
hook: Deck-building sets up fresh strategy every run.
risk: Bonus stacking can push strategy over skill; cap bonuses.

name: Boss Chart
loop: Four quick cards lead to a boss card with a long hidden path and many sub-questions; relics from earlier cards alter hints; the run ends after the boss.
hook: A mini-run with a climax in three minutes.
risk: Celebration visuals on a win could conflict with no-confetti rule on real trades; use synthetic only.

name: Relic Cards
loop: Correct calls drop relics such as longer reveal context or one free skip; relics last the run; a loss streak ends it; synthetic paths only.
hook: Roguelike build variety from a tiny input.
risk: Reward-loop compulsion; cap runs per day.

name: Hidden Axis
loop: Only the shape is visible; drag the percent range you expect at the end; hit the range and the axis labels fade in to show the real percentages.
hook: A satisfying reveal of units after the guess.
risk: Clear 0% reference needed before the guess.

name: Half Life Cards
loop: Predict whether a spike reverts at least half within the window; reveal shows the reversion line; codex stores examples of fading versus lasting moves.
hook: A crisp rule of thumb makes outcomes easy to grasp.
risk: Rules of thumb may be read as strategy; disclaim.

name: Fan Chart Flip
loop: Draw a fan of three widening bands over time; reveal shows which bands held the path; your result card shows a coverage rate against targets of 50 and 90 percent.
hook: The fan chart looks professional and shareable.
risk: Complex for casual users; auto-suggest default fans.

name: Ghost Writer
loop: Race the best-scoring anonymous forecaster for each card; their line is hidden until your answer; end-of-round ghost margin shows how close your calibration was.
hook: A rival to chase on every card.
risk: Best-ghost chase may demotivate; offer an average ghost.

name: Trader Tells
loop: Given an anonymised verified record's hold time and win rate, guess its average return bucket; reveal shows full stats including the sample size and its uncertainty.
hook: Learn how to read records skeptically, a core app value.
risk: Minimum aggregation thresholds needed so no trader is identifiable.

name: Prediction Pairs
loop: Two masked charts side by side; swipe toward the one that gains more over the hidden window; the reveal animates both and a relative bar shows the gap.
hook: Relative judgments are easier and more fun.
risk: Pairs might hint at relative stock picking; keep masked.

name: Shadow Mode
loop: Make three calls on delayed-live charts; watch others' aggregated calls move like weather over the day; resolve later; spectators see only aggregates.
hook: A living scoreboard that moves while you go about the day.
risk: Delayed-live disclosure and no real-time urging to act.

name: Trial By Fire
loop: Cards get harder as you pass them, with more noise and thinner context; log scoring makes certainty costly; a final screen shows your toughest level reached.
hook: A clear difficulty climb with a bragging stat.
risk: Log score extremes can frustrate; floor probabilities at 1 percent.

name: Candlelight Quiz
loop: Daily ten questions about famous historical market episodes shown as charts with names; guess what happened next; each answer adds to a timeline codex.
hook: History buffs get a learning loop.
risk: Named historical data may involve instruments; check POLICY on naming vendors.

name: Weather Report
loop: Forecast the next chart segment as sunny, cloudy, or stormy with confidence bars; the reveal paints a weather icon; a streak of calibrated forecasts earns icon sets.
hook: Weather metaphor lowers the intimidation barrier.
risk: Cute metaphor may trivialise money risk; keep clear paper-only label.

name: Dial A Duration
loop: Dial how long the trend continues before turning, in bars; scoring is a distance penalty; reveal marks the turning bar with a pin.
hook: Timing predictions feel different from direction guesses.
risk: Continuous scoring can be opaque; show the distance in plain terms.

name: Loss Lens
loop: Anonymised verified records are shown with the winners removed; swipe whether the next closed trade is a win or loss; teaches how losses cluster in real records.
hook: Counter-intuitive focus on losses matches app values.
risk: Removing winners misrepresents records; label as a teaching view.

name: Reveal Ritual
loop: Each reveal is a different quiet animation (curtain, tide, ink); your calibration unlocks new reveal styles; no sound, no flashes.
hook: The reveal itself is the collectible.
risk: Variable reward on reveals is slot-like; keep animations deterministic.

name: Squeeze Alert
loop: Charts show narrowing ranges; tap whether the range will expand upward, downward, or stay tight; reveal highlights the breakout candle.
hook: A tension-building setup before each reveal.
risk: Breakout framing implies tradable patterns; add past-performance disclaimer.

name: Two Minute Warmup
loop: A fixed-length 10-card warmup with no scores shown until the end; a final summary lists calibration, bias and best card type.
hook: Hidden mid-run scoring reduces tilt and keeps focus.
risk: Blind scoring may feel unrewarding; show a progress bar only.

name: Paper Trail Rounds
loop: Allocate paper capital across four masked paths before each reveal; reveal shows the percent result; eight rounds; score is paper return with equal weight on losses.
hook: Paper allocation is a quick strategy puzzle.
risk: Allocation play may read as portfolio advice; keep masked with disclaimers.

name: Risk Budget Rounds
loop: You get a fixed risk budget to spread over generated paths; the reveal scores return per unit of risk; teaches sizing without any real tickers.
hook: Sizing is the hidden skill and this makes it a game.
risk: Sizing lessons could be seen as advice; label synthetic and educational.

name: Scenario Flashes
loop: A short narrative about an unnamed fictional firm precedes each chart; pick what you expect; the reveal and a lesson card follow; stories are generic and fictional.
hook: Stories give context and emotional pull.
risk: Fictional news could look real; label clearly as fiction.

name: League Of Cards
loop: Friends join a private league; each week all play the same twelve cards; league table sorts by calibration with sample-size notes; no prizes.
hook: Weekly cadence suits friends without daily pressure.
risk: League shame dynamics; show tables with ties and uncertainty.

name: Spectator Stands
loop: Watch a high-rated forecaster's anonymised round replay in real time, swiping your own call alongside theirs before their reveal.
hook: Learn by playing along with a strong player.
risk: Anonymised player replays need consent and no leakage of identity.

name: Sandbox Sketchbook
loop: Create your own prediction card by drawing a chart and a hidden path from presets; friends solve it via link; creators get coverage stats only.
hook: User-made cards extend replay indefinitely.
risk: User content moderation burden; restrict to synthetic presets.

name: Mystery Month
loop: One daily puzzle chart with five stepwise questions; your result card shows five colored dots for the calibration of each answer, spoiler-free.
hook: A word-a-day style puzzle ritual with a shareable grid.
risk: Share grids drive daily habit; include an off switch.

name: Cold Open
loop: Open the app straight into a single card with no menu; one tap, one reveal, one-sentence takeaway; then you choose to stop or play another.
hook: Zero friction first impression for new visitors.
risk: No friction raises compulsion risk; add a gentle stop cue after ten.

name: Anti Hype Mode
loop: Cards include a loud fictional headline label; you predict anyway; the score shows how often hype labels beat or lagged the base rate in your own results.
hook: Teaches hype skepticism with personal evidence.
risk: Fictional headlines must not resemble real news.

name: Taste Of Randomness
loop: Swipe up or down on random walks you are told are random; your accuracy trends to 50 percent and a plot proves it, then the app shows a real-pattern deck for contrast.
hook: A playful humility lesson that is hard to forget.
risk: Might feel pointless; end with the real-pattern deck quickly.

name: Streak Of Truth
loop: A streak counts only when your probability was on the right side and at least 60 percent; bluffing 51 percent doesn't count; boards show best calibrated streak.
hook: Streaks that need real commitment feel earned.
risk: Streak boards invite grinding; limit entries per day.

name: Silent Auction Of Odds
loop: Spend 100 confidence points across three outcomes; points can't carry over; scoring blends Brier and paper return on the favored outcome; reveal shows what each point earned.
hook: Budgeting confidence is intuitive and strategic.
risk: Point budgets resemble betting; use no currency language.

name: Multi Horizon Mirror
loop: Same masked chart, five horizons from one minute to one month; a mirror view shows how your accuracy drifts with horizon; friends compare their curves.
hook: Your personal horizon profile is a novel identity.
risk: Long-horizon scoring needs resolve-time disclosure.

name: One Card Day
loop: A single card per day, one slider, resolved tomorrow; your log score accumulates in a quiet journal with no streaks and no rank.
hook: Gentle ritual with no pressure, easy to keep.
risk: Single-card days may be too thin for engagement.

name: Hot Seat Forecast
loop: A weekly group event: everyone predicts one delayed-live chart together, and the group's combined confidence meter fills up before the shared reveal.
hook: Shared anticipation creates a mini event.
risk: Group excitement can pressure participation; make it opt-in.

name: Mimic The Master
loop: Predict the outcome of an anonymised verified trader's next closed trade given their anonymous history; boards rank by calibration across many traders.
hook: Meta-game on top of the real verified feed.
risk: Risk of re-identification and of copy-trading nudges; high aggregation needed.

name: Slow Reveal Marathon
loop: Thirty cards in a single sitting once a week with a strict stop at the end; a long-form calibration report arrives afterwards with a plain-language summary.
hook: A deliberate counterweight to doom-scroll style play.
risk: Long session fatigue; allow pause and save.

name: Rival Ranges
loop: Both players draw ranges for the same masked card; the narrower range that still contains the outcome wins the point; reveal shows both ranges stacked.
hook: Tight-versus-tight duels feel like a skill contest.
risk: Link challenges can spam; rate-limit invites.

name: Kill Switch Cards
loop: After 15 cards a hard timeout locks the game until tomorrow with a brief calibration recap; designed to prevent binges and show restraint as a feature.
hook: Built-in stopping point is a trust signal.
risk: Players may resent limits; explain the reason plainly.

name: Verified Vs Guess
loop: Alternate between a masked historical card and an anonymised verified closed trade; your calibration on each source is compared so you learn which types of record you read well.
hook: Connects the game to the app's core promise of verified records.
risk: Mixed sources could blur Verified labels; badge every card.
